overview: AI-powered phone call platform that uses xAI's Voice API and Twilio to place real outbound calls with a fully configurable AI voice agent. Users set up call personas, select voices, configure conversation behavior, and let the AI conduct conversations reactively.
features: xAI Voice API integration with full session configurability
Twilio outbound call initiation with Media Streams bridge
Call configuration presets (voice, system prompt, VAD settings, tools)
Admin dashboard for xAI API key and Twilio credential management
Reactive AI conversation mode (listens first, responds on speech detection)
